verses.geez: ወከመዝ ፡ ይእቲ ፡ ልደቱ ፡ ለዔሳው ፡ ወውእቱ ፡ ለሊሁ ፡ ኤዶም ፡ ውእቱ ።
verses.translation: And these are the generations of Esau; this is Edom.

translations.lxx: And these are the generations of Esau; this is Edom.
translations.kjv: Now these are the generations of Esau, who is Edom.
translations.ron: Iar spiţa neamului lui Isav, care se mai numeşte şi Edom, este aceasta:
translations.grk: Αὗται δὲ αἱ γενέσεις Ἡσαῦ· αὐτός ἐστιν Ἐδώμ.

verses.geez:
ወነሥአ ፡ ሎቱ ፡ አንስቲያ ፡ እምነ ፡ አዋልደ ፡ ከናአን ፡ ሐዳሶ ፡ ወለተ ፡ ኤሎን ፡ ኬጥያዊ ፡ ወኤሌማ ፡ ወለተ ፡
                  ሐና ፡ ወልደ ፡ ሴቤስ ፡ ኤውያዊ ፤
verses.translation: And Esau took to himself wives of the daughters of the Chananites; Ada, the daughter of Ælom the Chettite; and Olibema, daughter of Ana the son of Sebegon, the Evite;

translations.lxx: And Esau took to himself wives of the daughters of the Chananites; Ada, the daughter of Ælom the Chettite; and Olibema, daughter of Ana the son of Sebegon, the Evite;
translations.kjv: Esau took his wives of the daughters of Canaan; Adah the daughter of Elon the Hittite, and Aholibamah the daughter of Anah the daughter of Zibeon the Hivite;
translations.ron: Isav şi-a luat femei din fetele Canaaneilor: pe Ada, fata lui Elon Heteul, şi pe Olibama, fata lui Ana, fiul lui Ţibon Heveul,
translations.grk: Ἡσαῦ δὲ ἔλαβε τὰς γυναῖκας ἑαυτῷ ἀπὸ τῶν θυγατέρων τῶν Χαναναίων· τὴν Ἀδὰ, θυγατέρα Αἰλὼμ τοῦ Χετταίου· καὶ τὴν Ὀλιβεμὰ, θυγατέρα Ἀνὰ τοῦ υἱοῦ Σεβεγὼν τοῦ Εὐαίου.

verses.geez: ወቤሴሞ[ት] ፡ ወለተ ፡ ይስማኤል ፡ እኅቱ ፡ ለናቡኦት ።
verses.translation: and Basemath, daughter of Ismael, sister of Nabaioth.

translations.lxx: and Basemath, daughter of Ismael, sister of Nabaioth.
translations.kjv: And Bashemath Ishmael’s daughter, sister of Nebajoth.
translations.ron: Şi pe Basemata, fata lui Ismael şi sora lui Nebaiot.
translations.grk: Καὶ τὴν Βασεμὰθ, θυγατέρα Ἰσμαὴλ, ἀδελφὴν Ναβαιώθ.

verses.geez: ወወለደቶ ፡ ሐዳሶ ፡ [ለኤልፋዝ ፡] ወቤሴሞት ፡ ወለደቶ ፡ ለራጉኤል ።
verses.translation: And Ada bore to him Eliphas; and Basemath bore Raguel.

translations.lxx: And Ada bore to him Eliphas; and Basemath bore Raguel.
translations.kjv: And Adah bare to Esau Eliphaz; and Bashemath bare Reuel;
translations.ron: Ada a născut lui Isav pe Elifaz; Basemata i-a născut pe Raguel;
translations.grk: Ἔτεκε δὲ αὐτῷ Ἀδὰ τὸν Ἑλιφάς· καὶ Βασεμὰθ ἔτεκε τὸν Ῥαγουήλ.

verses.geez:
ወኤሌማ ፡ ወለደቶ ፡ ለዮሔል ፡ ወለይጉ[ሜ]ል ፡ ወለቆሬ ፡ እሉ ፡ ደቂቁ ፡ ለዔሳው ፡ እለ ፡ ተወልዱ ፡ ሎቱ ፡ በምድረ
                  ፡ ከናአን ።
verses.translation: And Olibema bore Jeus, and Jeglom, and Core; these are the sons of Esau, which were born to him in the land of Chanaan.

translations.lxx: And Olibema bore Jeus, and Jeglom, and Core; these are the sons of Esau, which were born to him in the land of Chanaan.
translations.kjv: And Aholibamah bare Jeush, and Jaalam, and Korah: these are the sons of Esau, which were born unto him in the land of Canaan.
translations.ron: Iar Olibama i-a născut pe Ieuş, pe Ialam şi pe Core. Aceştia sunt fiii lui Isav, care i s-au născut în ţara Canaanului.
translations.grk: Καὶ Ὀλιβεμὰ ἔτεκε τὸν Ἰεοὺς, καὶ τὸν Ἰεγλὸμ, καὶ τὸν Κορέ· οὗτοι υἱοὶ Ἡσαῦ, οἳ ἐγένοντο αὐτῷ ἐν γῇ Χαναάν.

verses.geez:
ወነሥአ ፡ ዔሳው ፡ ደቂቆ ፡ ወአንስቲያሁ ፡ ወኵሎ ፡ ነባሬ ፡ ቤቱ ፡ ወኵሎ ፡ [እንስሳሁ ፡ ወኵሎ ፡] ንዋዮ ፡ ዘአጥረየ
                  ፡ በምድረ ፡ ከናአን ፡ ወሖረ ፡ ዔሳው ፡ እምነ ፡ ምድረ ፡ ከናአን ፡ እምነ ፡ ገጸ ፡ ያዕቆብ ፡ እኁሁ ።
verses.translation: And Esau took his wives, and his sons, and his daughters, and all the persons of his house, and all his possessions, and all his cattle, and all that he had got, and all things whatsoever he had acquired in the land of Chanaan; and Esau went forth from the land of Chanaan, from the face of his brother Jacob.

translations.lxx: And Esau took his wives, and his sons, and his daughters, and all the persons of his house, and all his possessions, and all his cattle, and all that he had got, and all things whatsoever he had acquired in the land of Chanaan; and Esau went forth from the land of Chanaan, from the face of his brother Jacob.
translations.kjv: And Esau took his wives, and his sons, and his daughters, and all the persons of his house, and his cattle, and all his beasts, and all his substance, which he had got in the land of Canaan; and went into the country from the face of his brother Jacob.
translations.ron: După aceea şi-a luat Isav femeile sale, fiii săi, fetele sale, toţi oamenii casei sale, toate averile sale, toate vitele sale şi toate câte avea şi toate câte agonisise în ţara Canaanului, şi a plecat Isav din Canaan din pricina lui Iacov, fratele său,
translations.grk: Ἔλαβε δὲ Ἡσαῦ τὰς γυναῖκας αὐτοῦ, καὶ τοὺς υἱοὺς αὐτοῦ, καὶ τὰς θυγατέρας αὐτοῦ, καὶ πάντα τὰ σώματα τοῦ οἴκου αὐτοῦ, καὶ πάντα τὰ ὑπάρχοντα αὐτοῦ, καὶ πάντα τὰ κτήνη, καὶ πάντα ὅσα ἐκτήσατο, καὶ πάντα ὅσα περιεποιήσατο ἐν γῇ Χαναάν· καὶ ἐπορεύθη Ἡσαῦ ἐκ τῆς γῆς Χαναὰν ἀπὸ προσώπου Ἰακὼβ τοῦ ἀδελφοῦ αὐτοῦ.

verses.geez: እስመ ፡ ብዙኅ ፡ ንዋዮሙ ፡ ወኢክህሉ ፡ ኅቡረ ፡ ነቢረ ፡ በእንተ ፡ ብዝኅ ፡ ንዋዮሙ ።
verses.translation: For their substance was too great for them to dwell together; and the land of their sojourning could not bear them, because of the abundance of their possessions.

translations.lxx: For their substance was too great for them to dwell together; and the land of their sojourning could not bear them, because of the abundance of their possessions.
translations.kjv: For their riches were more than that they might dwell together; and the land wherein they were strangers could not bear them because of their cattle.
translations.ron: Pentru că averile lor erau multe şi nu mai puteau să locuiască la un loc, şi pământul unde erau nu-i mai putea încăpea din pricina mulţimii turmelor lor.
translations.grk: Ἦν γὰρ αὐτῶν τὰ ὑπάρχοντα πολλὰ, τοῦ οἰκεῖν ἅμα· καὶ οὐκ ἠδύνατο ἡ γῆ τῆς παροικήσεως αὐτῶν φέρειν αὐτοὺς, ἀπὸ τοῦ πλήθους τῶν ὑπαρχόντων αὐτῶν.

verses.geez: ወኀደረ ፡ ዔሳው ፡ ውስተ ፡ ደብረ ፡ [ሴይር ፡] ወለሊሁ ፡ ዔሳው ፡ ኤዶም ፡ ውእቱ ።
verses.translation: And Esau dwelt in mount Seir; Esau, he is Edom.

translations.lxx: And Esau dwelt in mount Seir; Esau, he is Edom.
translations.kjv: Thus dwelt Esau in mount Seir: Esau is Edom.
translations.ron: Astfel Isav, care se mai numeşte şi Edom, s-a mutat în muntele Seir.
translations.grk: Κατῴκησε δὲ Ἡσαῦ ἐν τῷ ὄρει Σηείρ· Ἡσαῦ αὐτός ἐστιν Ἐδώμ.

verses.geez: ወከመዝ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ፍጥረቱ ፡ ለዔሳው ፡ አቡሆሙ ፡ ለኤዶም ፡ በደብረ ፡ ሴይር ።
verses.translation: And these are the generations of Esau, the father of Edom in the mount Seir.

translations.lxx: And these are the generations of Esau, the father of Edom in the mount Seir.
translations.kjv: And these are the generations of Esau the father of the Edomites in mount Seir:
translations.ron: Iată acum şi urmaşii ce i s-au născut lui Isav, părintele Edomiţilor, după mutarea sa în muntele Seir.
translations.grk: Αὗται δὲ αἱ γενέσεις Ἡσαῦ πατρὸς Ἐδὼμ ἐν τῷ ὄρει Σηείρ.

verses.geez:
ወከመዝ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ አስማቲሆሙ ፡ ለደቂቀ ፡ ዔሳው ፡ [ኤልፋዝ ፡ ወልደ ፡ ሐደሶ ፡ ብእሲተ ፡ ዔሳው ፡ ወራጉኤል ፡ ወልደ
                  ፡ ቤሴሞት ፡ ብእሲተ ፡ ዔሳው ።
verses.translation: And these are the names of the sons of Esau. Eliphas, the son of Ada, the wife of Esau; and Raguel, the son of Basemath, wife of Esau.

translations.lxx: And these are the names of the sons of Esau. Eliphas, the son of Ada, the wife of Esau; and Raguel, the son of Basemath, wife of Esau.
translations.kjv: These are the names of Esau’s sons; Eliphaz the son of Adah the wife of Esau, Reuel the son of Bashemath the wife of Esau.
translations.ron: Numele fiilor lui Isav sunt acestea: Elifaz, fiul Adei, solia lui Isav şi Raguel, fiul Basematei, soţia lui Isav.
translations.grk: Καὶ ταῦτα τὰ ὀνόματα τῶν υἱῶν Ἡσαῦ· Ἑλιφὰς υἱὸς Ἀδὰς γυναικὸς Ἡσαῦ· καὶ Ῥαγουὴλ υἱὸς Βασεμὰθ γυναικὸς Ἡσαῦ.

verses.geez: ወኮነ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ ኤልፋዝ ፡ ወልደ ፡ ዔሳው ፡ ቴማን ፡ ወኤሞር ፡ ወሳፍር ፡ ወጎቶን ፡ ወቄኔዝ ።
verses.translation: And the sons of Eliphas were Thæman, Omar, Sophar, Gothom, and Kenez.

translations.lxx: And the sons of Eliphas were Thæman, Omar, Sophar, Gothom, and Kenez.
translations.kjv: And the sons of Eliphaz were Teman, Omar, Zepho, and Gatam, and Kenaz.
translations.ron: Elifaz, a avut cinci feciori: Teman, Omar, Ţefo, Gatam şi Chenaz;
translations.grk: Ἐγένοντο δὲ Ἑλιφὰς υἱοὶ, Θαιμὰν, Ὠμὰρ, Σωφὰρ, Γοθὼμ, καὶ Κενέζ.

verses.geez:
ወተምናሕ ፡ ዕቅብቱ ፡ ለኤልፋዝ ፡ ወልደ ፡ ዔሳው ፡ ወለደት ፡ ሎቱ ፡ አማሌቅሃ ፡ እሉ ፡ እሙንቱ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ ሐዳሶ ፡
                  ብእሲተ ፡ ዔሳው ።
verses.translation: And Thamna was a concubine of Eliphaz, the son of Esau; and she bore Amalec to Eliphas. These are the sons of Ada, the wife of Esau.

translations.lxx: And Thamna was a concubine of Eliphaz, the son of Esau; and she bore Amalec to Eliphas. These are the sons of Ada, the wife of Esau.
translations.kjv: And Timna was concubine to Eliphaz Esau’s son; and she bare to Eliphaz Amalek: these were the sons of Adah Esau’s wife.
translations.ron: Iar Timna, o ţiitoare a lui Elifaz, fiul lui Isav, i-a născut lui Elifaz pe Amalec. Aceştia sunt urmaşii din Ada, femeia lui Isav.
translations.grk: Θαμνὰ δὲ ἦν παλλακὴ Ἑλιφὰς τοῦ υἱοῦ Ἡσαῦ· καὶ ἔτεκε τῷ Ἑλιφὰς τὸν Ἀμαλήκ· οὗτοι υἱοὶ Ἀδὰς γυναικὸς Ἡσαῦ.

verses.geez:
ወደቂቀ ፡ ራጉኤል ፡ ወልደ ፡ ዔሳው ፡ ናሖት ፡ ወዛራ ፡ ወሲም ፡ ወምዛኅ ፤ እሉ ፡ እሙንቱ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ ቤሴሞት ፡
                  ብእሲተ ፡ ዔሳው ።
verses.translation: And these are the sons of Raguel; Nachoth, Zare, Some, and Moze. These were the sons of Basemath, wife of Esau.

translations.lxx: And these are the sons of Raguel; Nachoth, Zare, Some, and Moze. These were the sons of Basemath, wife of Esau.
translations.kjv: And these are the sons of Reuel; Nahath, and Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah: these were the sons of Bashemath Esau’s wife.
translations.ron: Iar feciorii lui Raguel sunt aceştia: Nahat şi Zerah, Şama şi Miza. Aceştia sunt urmaşii din Basemata, femeia lui Isav.
translations.grk: Οὗτοι δὲ υἱοὶ Ῥαγουὴλ, Ναχὼθ, Ζαρὲ, Σομὲ, καὶ Μοζέ· οὗτοι ἦσαν υἱοὶ Βασεμὰθ γυναικὸς Ἡσαῦ.

verses.geez:
ወእሉ ፡ እሙንቱ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ ኤሌማ ፡ ወለተ ፡ ሐና ፡ ብእሲተ ፡ ዔሳው ፡ ዘወለደት ፡ ለዔሳው ፡ ዮሔል ፡ ወይጉሜል ፡
                  ወቆሬ ።
verses.translation: And these are the sons of Olibema, the daughter of Ana, the son of Sebegon, the wife of Esau; and she bore to Esau, Jeus, and Jeglom, and Core.

translations.lxx: And these are the sons of Olibema, the daughter of Ana, the son of Sebegon, the wife of Esau; and she bore to Esau, Jeus, and Jeglom, and Core.
translations.kjv: And these were the sons of Aholibamah, the daughter of Anah the daughter of Zibeon, Esau’s wife: and she bare to Esau Jeush, and Jaalam, and Korah.
translations.ron: Iar feciorii Olibamei, femeia lui Isav şi fiica lui Ana a lui Ţibon, sunt aceştia: ea a născut lui Isav pe Ieuş, pe Ialam şi pe Core.
translations.grk: Οὗτοι δὲ υἱοὶ Ὀλιβεμὰς θυγατρὸς Ἀνὰ τοῦ υἱοῦ Σεβεγὼν, γυναικὸς Ἡσαῦ· ἔτεκε δὲ τῷ Ἡσαῦ τὸν Ἰεοὺς, καὶ τὸν Ἰεγλὸμ, καὶ τὸν Κορέ.

verses.geez:
ወእሉ ፡ እሙንቱ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ ዔሳው ፡ መሳፍንት ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ ኤልፋዝ ፡ በኵሩ ፡ ለዔሳው ፡ ቴማን ፡ መስፍን ፡ ወኤሞር ፡
                  መስፍን ፡ ወሳፍር ፡ መስፍን ፡ ወቄኔዝ ፡ መስፍን ፤
verses.translation: These are the chiefs of the son of Esau, even the sons of Eliphas, the first-born of Esau; chief Thæman, chief Omar, chief Sophar, chief Kenez,

translations.lxx: These are the chiefs of the son of Esau, even the sons of Eliphas, the first-born of Esau; chief Thæman, chief Omar, chief Sophar, chief Kenez,
translations.kjv: These were dukes of the sons of Esau: the sons of Eliphaz the firstborn son of Esau; duke Teman, duke Omar, duke Zepho, duke Kenaz,
translations.ron: Iată şi căpeteniile fiilor lui Isav: feciorii lui Elifaz, întâi-născutul lui Isav, sunt: căpetenia Teman, căpetenia Omar, căpetenia Ţefo, căpetenia Chenaz,
translations.grk: Οὗτοι ἡγεμόνες υἱοὶ Ἡσαῦ· υἱοὶ Ἑλιφὰς πρωτοτόκου Ἡσαῦ· ἡγεμὼν Θαιμὰν, ἡγεμὼν Ὠμὰρ, ἡγεμὼν Σωφὰρ, ἡγεμὼν Κενὲζ,

verses.geez:
ወቆሬ ፡ መስፍን ፡ ወጎቶን ፡ መስፍን ፡ ወአማሌቅ ፡ መስፍን ፤ እሉ ፡ እሙንቱ ፡ መሳፍንተ ፡ ኤልፋዝ ፡ በምድረ ፡ ኤዶም
                  ፡ እለ ፡ ተወልዱ ፡ እምነ ፡ ሐዳሶ ።
verses.translation: chief Core, chief Gothom, chief Amalec. These are the chiefs of Eliphas, in the land of Edom; these are the sons of Ada.

translations.lxx: chief Core, chief Gothom, chief Amalec. These are the chiefs of Eliphas, in the land of Edom; these are the sons of Ada.
translations.kjv: Duke Korah, duke Gatam, and duke Amalek: these are the dukes that came of Eliphaz in the land of Edom; these were the sons of Adah.
translations.ron: Căpetenia Core, căpetenia Gatam şi căpetenia Amalec. Acestea sunt căpeteniile din Elifaz în ţara Edomului; aceştia sunt urmaşii din Ada.
translations.grk: ἡγεμὼν Κορὲ, ἡγεμὼν Γοθὼμ, ἡγεμὼν Ἀμαλήκ· οὗτοι ἡγεμόνες Ἑλιφὰς ἐν γῇ Ἰδουμαίᾳ· οὗτοι υἱοὶ Ἀδάς.

verses.geez:
ወእሉ ፡ እሙንቱ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ ራጉኤል ፡ ወልደ ፡ ዔሳው ፡ መሳፍንት ፡ ናሖት ፡ መስፍን ፡ ወዛራ ፡ መስፍን ፡ ወሲም ፡
                  መስፍን ፡ ወምዛኅ ፡ መስፍን ፤ እሉ ፡ እሙንቱ ፡ መሳፍንተ ፡ ራጉኤል ፡ በምድረ ፡ ኤዶም ፡ እለ ፡ ተወልዱ ፡ እምነ ፡
                  ቤሴሞት ፡ ብእሲተ ፡ ዔሳው ።
verses.translation: And these are the sons of Raguel, the son of Esau; chief Nachoth, chief Zare, chief Some, chief Moze. These are the chiefs of Raguel, in the land of Edom; these are the sons of Basemath, wife of Esau.

translations.lxx: And these are the sons of Raguel, the son of Esau; chief Nachoth, chief Zare, chief Some, chief Moze. These are the chiefs of Raguel, in the land of Edom; these are the sons of Basemath, wife of Esau.
translations.kjv: And these are the sons of Reuel Esau’s son; duke Nahath, duke Zerah, duke Shammah, duke Mizzah: these are the dukes that came of Reuel in the land of Edom; these are the sons of Bashemath Esau’s wife.
translations.ron: Iar fiii lui Raguel, fiul lui Isav, sunt: căpetenia Nahat, căpetenia Zerah, căpetenia Şama şi căpetenia Miza. Acestea sunt căpeteniile din Raguel în ţara Edomului; aceştia sunt urmaşii din Basemata, femeia lui Isav.
translations.grk: Καὶ οὗτοι υἱοὶ Ῥαγουὴλ υἱοῦ Ἡσαῦ· ἡγεμὼν Ναχὼθ, ἡγεμὼν Ζαρὲ, ἡγεμὼν Σομὲ, ἡγεμὼν Μοζέ· οὗτοι ἡγεμόνες Ῥαγουὴλ ἐν γῇ Ἐδώμ· οὗτοι υἱοὶ Βασεμὰθ γυναικὸς Ἡσαῦ.

verses.geez:
ወእሉ ፡ እሙንቱ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ ኤሌማ ፡ ብእሲተ ፡ ዔሳው ፡ መሳፍንት ፡ ዮሔል ፡ መስፍን ፡ ወይጉሜል ፡ መስፍን ፡ ወቆሬ ፡
                  መስፍን ።
verses.translation: And these are the sons of Olibema, wife of Esau; chief Jeus, chief Jeglom, chief Core. These are the chiefs of Olibema, daughter of Ana, wife of Esau.

translations.lxx: And these are the sons of Olibema, wife of Esau; chief Jeus, chief Jeglom, chief Core. These are the chiefs of Olibema, daughter of Ana, wife of Esau.
translations.kjv: And these are the sons of Aholibamah Esau’s wife; duke Jeush, duke Jaalam, duke Korah: these were the dukes that came of Aholibamah the daughter of Anah, Esau’s wife.
translations.ron: Iată şi fiii Olibamei, femeia lui Isav: căpetenia Ieuş, căpetenia Ialam şi căpetenia Core. Acestea sunt căpeteniile din Olibama, fata lui Ana şi femeia lui Isav.
translations.grk: Οὗτοι δὲ υἱοὶ Ὀλιβεμὰς γυναικὸς Ἡσαῦ· ἡγεμὼν Ἰεοὺς, ἡγεμὼν Ἰεγλὸμ, ἡγεμὼν Κορέ· οὗτοι ἡγεμόνες Ὀλιβεμὰς θυγατρὸς Ἀνὰ γυναικὸς Ἡσαῦ.

verses.geez: እሉ ፡ እሙንቱ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ ዔሳው ፡ መሳፍንተ ፡ ኤዶም ።
verses.translation: These are the sons of Esau, and these are the chiefs; these are the sons of Edom.

translations.lxx: These are the sons of Esau, and these are the chiefs; these are the sons of Edom.
translations.kjv: These are the sons of Esau, who is Edom, and these are their dukes.
translations.ron: Aceştia sunt fiii lui Isav şi acestea sunt căpeteniile lor. Acesta este Edom.
translations.grk: Οὗτοι υἱοὶ Ἡσαῦ, καὶ οὗτοι ἡγεμόνες αὐτῶν· οὗτοί εἰσιν υἱοὶ Ἐδώμ.

verses.geez:
ወእሉ ፡ እሙንቱ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ ሴይር ፡ ሆርያዊ ፡ እለ ፡ ይነብሩ ፡ ዲበ ፡ ምድር ፡ ሉጣን ፡ ወሶባን ፡ ወሳባቅ ፡ ወአናን
                  ፤
verses.translation: And these are the sons of Seir, the Chorrhite, who inhabited the land; Lotan, Sobal, Sebegon, Ana,

translations.lxx: And these are the sons of Seir, the Chorrhite, who inhabited the land; Lotan, Sobal, Sebegon, Ana,
translations.kjv: These are the sons of Seir the Horite, who inhabited the land; Lotan, and Shobal, and Zibeon, and Anah,
translations.ron: Iar feciorii lui Seir Horeeanul, care locuiau înainte pământul acela, sunt: Lotan, Şobal, Ţibon şi Ana;
translations.grk: Οὗτοι δὲ υἱοὶ Σηεὶρ τοῦ Χοῤῥαίου, τοῦ κατοικοῦντος τὴν γῆν· Λωτὰν, Σωβὰλ, Σεβεγὼν, Ἀνὰ,

verses.geez: ወዲሶን ፡ ወኢሶር ፡ *ወዲሳን* ፤ እሉ ፡ እሙንቱ ፡ መሳፍንትሂ ፡ ኆርያዊ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ ሴይር ።
verses.translation: and Deson, and Asar, and Rison. These are the chiefs of the Chorrhite, the son of Seir, in the land of Edom.

translations.lxx: and Deson, and Asar, and Rison. These are the chiefs of the Chorrhite, the son of Seir, in the land of Edom.
translations.kjv: And Dishon, and Ezer, and Dishan: these are the dukes of the Horites, the children of Seir in the land of Edom.
translations.ron: Dişon, Eţer şi Dişan. Acestea sunt căpeteniile Horeilor, feciorii lui Seir, în pământul Edomului.
translations.grk: καὶ Δησὼν, καὶ Ἀσὰρ, καὶ Ῥισών· οὗτοι ἡγεμόνες τοῦ Χοῤῥαίου, τοῦ υἱοῦ Σηεὶρ ἐν τῇ γῇ Ἐδώμ.

verses.geez: ወእሉ ፡ እሙንቱ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ ሉጣን ፡ ሑሪ ፡ ወሐማን ፡ ወእኅተ ፡ ሉጣን ፡ ትምናእ ።
verses.translation: And the sons of Lotan were Chorrhi and Hæman; and the sister of Lotan, Thamna.

translations.lxx: And the sons of Lotan were Chorrhi and Hæman; and the sister of Lotan, Thamna.
translations.kjv: And the children of Lotan were Hori and Hemam; and Lotan’s sister was Timna.
translations.ron: Fiii lui Lotan sunt: Hori şi Heman, iar sora lui Lotan a fost Timna.
translations.grk: Ἐγένοντο δὲ υἱοὶ Λωτάν· Χοῤῥὶ, καὶ Αἱμάν· ἀδελφὴ δὲ Λωτὰν, Θαμνά.

verses.geez: ወደቂቀ ፡ ሶባን ፡ አልዋን ፡ ወማኔሐት ፡ ወአቤል ፡ ወሰፋ ፡ ወአውናም ።
verses.translation: And these are the sons of Sobal; Golam, and Manachath, and Gæbel, and Sophar, and Omar.

translations.lxx: And these are the sons of Sobal; Golam, and Manachath, and Gæbel, and Sophar, and Omar.
translations.kjv: And the children of Shobal were these; Alvan, and Manahath, and Ebal, Shepho, and Onam.
translations.ron: Fiii lui Şobal sunt: Alvan, Manahat, Ebal, Şefo şi Onam.
translations.grk: Οὗτοι δὲ υἱοὶ Σωβάλ· Γωλὰμ, καὶ Μαναχὰθ, καὶ Γαιβὴλ, καὶ Σωφὰρ, καὶ Ὠμάρ.

verses.geez:
ወእሉ ፡ እሙንቱ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ ሳባቅ ፡ ኤአ ፡ ወአናን ፡ ወውእቱ ፡ አናን ፡] ዘረከቦ ፡ ለያሜን ፡ በገዳም ፡ እንዘ ፡
                  ይትረዐዩ ፡ አዕዱጊሁ ፡ ለ[ሳባቅ] ፡ አቡሁ ።
verses.translation: And these are the sons of Sebegon; Aïe, and Ana; this is the Ana who found Jamin in the wilderness, when he tended the beasts of his father Sebegon.

translations.lxx: And these are the sons of Sebegon; Aïe, and Ana; this is the Ana who found Jamin in the wilderness, when he tended the beasts of his father Sebegon.
translations.kjv: And these are the children of Zibeon; both Ajah, and Anah: this was that Anah that found the mules in the wilderness, as he fed the asses of Zibeon his father.
translations.ron: Fiii lui Ţibon sunt: Aia şi Ana. Acesta este acel Ana, care a găsit izvoarele de apă caldă în pustie, când păştea asinii tatălui său Ţibon.
translations.grk: Καὶ οὗτοι υἱοὶ Σεβεγὼν, Ἀϊὲ, καὶ Ἀνά· οὗτός ἐστιν Ἀνὰ, ὃς εὗρε τὸν Ἰαμεὶν ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ, ὅτε ἔνεμε τὰ ὑποζύγια Σεβεγὼν τοῦ πατρὸς αὐτοῦ·

verses.geez: [ወእሉ ፡ እሙንቱ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ አናን ፡ ዲሶን ፡ ወኤሌሚ ፡ ወለተ ፡ አናን ።
verses.translation: And these are the sons of Ana; Deson—and Olibema was daughter of Ana.

translations.lxx: And these are the sons of Ana; Deson—and Olibema was daughter of Ana.
translations.kjv: And the children of Anah were these; Dishon, and Aholibamah the daughter of Anah.
translations.ron: Copiii lui Ana sunt: Dişon şi Olibama, fata lui Ana.
translations.grk: Οὗτοι δὲ υἱοὶ Ἀνά· Δησὼν, καὶ Ὀλιβεμὰ θυγάτηρ Ἀνά.

verses.geez: ወእሉ ፡ እሙንቱ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ ዲሶን ፡ ሕምዳን ፡ ወአስባን ፡ ወይትራን ፡ ወክራን ።
verses.translation: And these are the sons of Deson; Amada, and Asban, and Ithran, and Charrhan.

translations.lxx: And these are the sons of Deson; Amada, and Asban, and Ithran, and Charrhan.
translations.kjv: And these are the children of Dishon; Hemdan, and Eshban, and Ithran, and Cheran.
translations.ron: Copiii lui Dişon sunt: Hemdan, Eşban, Itran şi Cheran.
translations.grk: Οὗτοι δὲ υἱοὶ Δησών· Ἀμαδὰ, καὶ Ἀσβὰν, καὶ Ἰθρὰν, καὶ Χαῤῥάν.

verses.geez: ወእሉ ፡ እሙንቱ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ ኢሶር ፡ ብልሐን ፡ ወዛኦን ፡ ወአቃን ።
verses.translation: And these are the sons of Asar; Balaam, and Zucam, and Jucam.

translations.lxx: And these are the sons of Asar; Balaam, and Zucam, and Jucam.
translations.kjv: The children of Ezer are these; Bilhan, and Zaavan, and Akan.
translations.ron: Fiii lui Eţer sunt: Bilhan, Zaavan şi Acan.
translations.grk: Οὗτοι δὲ υἱοὶ Ἀσάρ· Βαλαὰμ, καὶ Ζουκὰμ, καὶ Ἰουκάμ.

verses.geez: ወእሉ ፡ (እንከ ፡) ደቂቀ ፡ ዲሳን ፡ ዑሳ ፡ ወአራን ።
verses.translation: And these are the sons of Rison; Hos, and Aran.

translations.lxx: And these are the sons of Rison; Hos, and Aran.
translations.kjv: The children of Dishan are these; Uz, and Aran.
translations.ron: Fiii lui Dişan sunt: Uţ şi Aran.
translations.grk: Οὗτοι δὲ υἱοὶ Ῥισὼν, Ὧς, καὶ Ἀράν.

verses.geez:
ወእሉ ፡ እሙንቱ ፡ መሳፍንተ ፡ ሆሪ ፡ ሉጣን ፡ መስፍን ፡ ወሶባን ፡ መስፍን ፡ ወሳባቅ ፡ *መስፍን ፡ ወአናን* ፡
                  መስፍን ፤
verses.translation: And these are the chiefs of Chorri; chief Lotan, chief Sobal, chief Sebegon, chief Ana,

translations.lxx: And these are the chiefs of Chorri; chief Lotan, chief Sobal, chief Sebegon, chief Ana,
translations.kjv: These are the dukes that came of the Horites; duke Lotan, duke Shobal, duke Zibeon, duke Anah,
translations.ron: Deci căpeteniile Horeilor sunt acestea: căpetenia Lotan, căpetenia Şobal, căpetenia Ţibon, căpetenia Ana,
translations.grk: Οὗτοι δὲ ἡγεμόνες Χοῤῥί· ἡγεμὼν Λωτὰν, ἡγεμὼν Σωβὰλ, ἡγεμὼν Σεβεγὼν, ἡγεμὼν Ἀνὰ,

verses.geez:
ወዲሶን ፡ መስፍን ፡ ወኢሶር ፡ መስፍን ፡ ወ*ዲሳ*ን ፡ መስፍን ፤ እሉ ፡ እሙንቱ ፡ መሳፍንተ ፡ ሆሪ ፡ በበመሳፍንቲሆሙ
                  ፡ ውስተ ፡ ምድረ ፡ ሴይር ።]
verses.translation: chief Deson, chief Asar, chief Rison. These are the chiefs of Chorri, in their principalities in the land of Edom.

translations.lxx: chief Deson, chief Asar, chief Rison. These are the chiefs of Chorri, in their principalities in the land of Edom.
translations.kjv: Duke Dishon, duke Ezer, duke Dishan: these are the dukes that came of Hori, among their dukes in the land of Seir.
translations.ron: Căpetenia Dişon, căpetenia Eţer, căpetenia Dişan. Acestea sunt căpeteniile Horeilor din ţara lui Seir, după familiile lor.
translations.grk: ἡγεμὼν Δησὼν, ἡγεμὼν Ἀσὰρ, ἡγεμὼν Ῥισών· οὗτοι ἡγεμόνες Χοῤῥὶ ἐν ταῖς ἡγεμονίαις αὐτῶν ἐν γῇ Ἐδώμ.

verses.geez: ወእሉ ፡ እሙንቱ ፡ ነገሥት ፡ እለ ፡ ነግሡ ፡ በኤዶም ፡ ዘእንበለ ፡ ይንግሥ ፡ ንጉሥ ፡ ለእስራኤል ።
verses.translation: And these are the kings which reigned in Edom, before a king reigned in Israel.

translations.lxx: And these are the kings which reigned in Edom, before a king reigned in Israel.
translations.kjv: And these are the kings that reigned in the land of Edom, before there reigned any king over the children of Israel.
translations.ron: Iată şi regii, care au domnit în pământul Edomului înainte de a domni vreun rege peste fiii lui Israel:
translations.grk: Καὶ οὗτοι οἱ βασιλεῖς οἱ βασιλεύσαντες ἐν Ἐδὼμ, πρὸ τοῦ βασιλεῦσαι βασιλέα ἐν Ἰσραήλ.

verses.geez: ወነግሠ ፡ በኤዶም ፡ ባ[ላ]ቅ ፡ [ወልደ ፡ ቤኦር ፡ ወስመ ፡ ሀገሩ ፡ ዲናባ ።
verses.translation: And Balac, son of Beor, reigned in Edom; and the name of his city was Dennaba.

translations.lxx: And Balac, son of Beor, reigned in Edom; and the name of his city was Dennaba.
translations.kjv: And Bela the son of Beor reigned in Edom: and the name of his city was Dinhabah.
translations.ron: În Edom a domnit mai întâi Bela, fiul lui Beor şi cetatea lui se numea Dinhaba.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐβασίλευσεν ἐν Ἐδὼμ Βαλὰκ υἱὸς Βεώρ· καὶ ὄνομα τῇ πόλει αὐτοῦ, Δενναβά.

verses.geez: ወሞተ ፡ ባላቅ ፡] ወነግሠ ፡ ህየንቴሁ ፡ ኢ[ዮ]ባብ ፡ ወልደ ፡ ዛራ ፡ ዘእምነ ፡ ቦሶራ ።
verses.translation: And Balac died; and Jobab, son of Zara, from Bosorrha reigned in his stead.

translations.lxx: And Balac died; and Jobab, son of Zara, from Bosorrha reigned in his stead.
translations.kjv: And Bela died, and Jobab the son of Zerah of Bozrah reigned in his stead.
translations.ron: După ce a murit Bela, s-a făcut rege Iobab, fiul lui Zerah din Boţra.
translations.grk: Ἀπέθανε δὲ Βαλὰκ, καὶ ἐβασίλευσεν ἀντʼ αὐτοῦ Ἰωβὰβ υἱὸς Ζαρὰ ἐκ Βοσόῤῥας.

verses.geez: *ወሞተ ፡ ኢዮባብ ፡ ወነግሠ ፡ ህየንቴሁ ፡ ሑሳም ፡ ዘእምነ ፡ ምድረ ፡ ቴማኒ ።
verses.translation: And Jobab died; and Asom, from the land of the Thæmanites, reigned in his stead.

translations.lxx: And Jobab died; and Asom, from the land of the Thæmanites, reigned in his stead.
translations.kjv: And Jobab died, and Husham of the land of Temani reigned in his stead.
translations.ron: După ce a murit Iobab, s-a făcut rege Huşam, din ţara Temaniţilor.
translations.grk: Ἀπέθανε δὲ Ἰωβὰβ, καὶ ἐβασίλευσεν ἀντʼ αὐτοῦ Ἀσὼμ ἐκ τῆς γῆς Θαιμανών.

verses.geez:
ወሞተ ፡ ሑሳም ፡ ወነግሠ ፡ ህየንቴሁ ፡ አደድ ፡ ወልደ ፡ ብደድ ፡ ዘቀተሎሙ ፡ ለምድያም ፡ በሐቅለ ፡ ሞአብ ፡ ወስመ ፡
                  ሀገሩ ፡ ዐዊት ።
verses.translation: And Asom died; and Adad son of Barad, who cut off Madiam in the plain of Moab, ruled in his stead; and the name of his city was Getthaim.

translations.lxx: And Asom died; and Adad son of Barad, who cut off Madiam in the plain of Moab, ruled in his stead; and the name of his city was Getthaim.
translations.kjv: And Husham died, and Hadad the son of Bedad, who smote Midian in the field of Moab, reigned in his stead: and the name of his city was Avith.
translations.ron: După ce a murit Huşam, s-a făcut rege Hadad, feciorul lui Bedad; care a bătut pe Madianiţi în câmpul Moab; numele cetăţii lui era Avit.
translations.grk: Ἀπέθανε δὲ Ἀσὼμ, καὶ ἐβασίλευσεν ἀντʼ αὐτοῦ Ἀδὰδ υἱὸς Βαρὰδ ὁ ἐκκόψας Μαδιὰμ ἐν τῷ πεδίῳ Μωάβ· καὶ ὄνομα τῇ πόλει αὐτοῦ Γετθαίμ.

verses.geez: ወሞተ ፡ አዳድ ፡ ወነግሠ ፡ ህየንቴሁ ፡ ሰምላ ፡ ዘእምነ ፡ መስርቃ ።
verses.translation: And Adad died; and Samada of Massecca reigned in his stead.

translations.lxx: And Adad died; and Samada of Massecca reigned in his stead.
translations.kjv: And Hadad died, and Samlah of Masrekah reigned in his stead.
translations.ron: Iar după ce a murit Hadad, s-a făcut rege Samla, din Masreca.
translations.grk: Ἀπέθανε δὲ Ἀδὰδ, καὶ ἐβασίλευσεν ἀντʼ αὐτοῦ Σαμαδὰ ἐκ Μασσεκκάς.

verses.geez: ወሞተ ፡ ሰምላ ፡ ወነግሠ ፡ ህየንቴሁ ፡ ሳኦል ፡ ዘእምነ ፡ ሮኦቦት ፡ እንተ ፡ ፈለግ ።
verses.translation: And Samada died; and Saul of Rhoöboth by the river reigned in his stead.

translations.lxx: And Samada died; and Saul of Rhoöboth by the river reigned in his stead.
translations.kjv: And Samlah died, and Saul of Rehoboth by the river reigned in his stead.
translations.ron: Iar după ce a murit Samla, s-a făcut rege, în locul lui, Şaul, din Rehobotul de pe râu.
translations.grk: Ἀπέθανε δὲ Σαμαδὰ, καὶ ἐβασίλευσεν ἀντʼ αὐτοῦ Σαοὺλ ἐκ Ῥοωβὼθ τῆς παρὰ ποταμόν.

verses.geez: ወሞተ ፡ ሳኦል ፡ ወነግሠ ፡ ህየንቴሁ ፡ በአለናን ፡ ወልደ ፡ አክቦር ።
verses.translation: And Saul died; and Ballenon the son of Achobor reigned in his stead.

translations.lxx: And Saul died; and Ballenon the son of Achobor reigned in his stead.
translations.kjv: And Saul died, and Baalhanan the son of Achbor reigned in his stead.
translations.ron: Iar după ce a murit Şaul, s-a făcut rege Baal-Hanan, fiul lui Acbor.
translations.grk: Ἀπέθανε δὲ Σαοὺλ, καὶ ἐβασίλευσεν ἀντʼ αὐτοῦ Βαλλενὼν υἱὸς Ἀχοβώρ.

verses.geez:
ወሞተ ፡ በአለናን ፡ ወልደ ፡ አክቦር ፡ ወነግሠ ፡ ህየንቴሁ ፡ አደር ፡ ወስመ ፡ ሀገሩ ፡ ፍጉ ፡ ወስመ ፡ ብእሲቱ ፡
                  ምኤጠብኤል ፡ ወለተ ፡ መጥሬድ ፡ ወለተ ፡ ሜዘአብ* ።
verses.translation: And Ballenon the son of Achobor died; and Arad the son of Barad reigned in his stead; and the name of his city was Phogor; and the name of his wife was Metebeel, daughter of Matraith, son of Maizoöb.

translations.lxx: And Ballenon the son of Achobor died; and Arad the son of Barad reigned in his stead; and the name of his city was Phogor; and the name of his wife was Metebeel, daughter of Matraith, son of Maizoöb.
translations.kjv: And Baalhanan the son of Achbor died, and Hadar reigned in his stead: and the name of his city was Pau; and his wife’s name was Mehetabel, the daughter of Matred, the daughter of Mezahab.
translations.ron: Iar după ce a murit Baal-Hanan, feciorul lui Acbor, s-a făcut rege Hadar, fiul lui Varad, şi numele cetăţii lui era Pau şi al femeii lui Mehetabel, fiica lui Matred, feciorul lui Mezahab.
translations.grk: Ἀπέθανε δὲ Βαλλενὼν υἱὸς Ἀχοβὼρ, καὶ ἐβασίλευσεν ἀντʼ αὐτοῦ Ἀρὰδ υἱὸς Βαράδ· καὶ ὄνομα τῇ πόλει αὐτοῦ Φογώρ· ὄνομα δὲ τῇ γυναικὶ αὐτοῦ Μετεβεὴλ, θυγάτηρ Ματραῒθ, υἱοῦ Μαιζοώβ.

verses.geez:
ወዝንቱ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ አስማቲሆሙ ፡ ለመሳፍንተ ፡ ዔሳው ፡ በበነገዶሙ ፡ ወበበብሔሮሙ ፡ *ወበበ ፡ አስማቲሆሙ ፡ ትምናዕ ፡
                  መስፍን ፡ ዐልዋ ፡ መስፍን ፡ ኢቴት ፡ መስፍን ፤
verses.translation: These are the names of the chiefs of Esau, in their tribes, according to their place, in their countries, and in their nations; chief Thamna, chief Gola, chief Jether,

translations.lxx: These are the names of the chiefs of Esau, in their tribes, according to their place, in their countries, and in their nations; chief Thamna, chief Gola, chief Jether,
translations.kjv: And these are the names of the dukes that came of Esau, according to their families, after their places, by their names; duke Timnah, duke Alvah, duke Jetheth,
translations.ron: Iar numele căpeteniilor din Isav, după triburile lor, după ţările lor, după numirile şi naţiile lor sunt: căpetenia Timna, căpetenia Alvan, căpetenia Ietet,
translations.grk: Ταῦτα τὰ ὀνόματα τῶν ἡγεμόνων Ἡσαῦ, ἐν ταῖς φυλαῖς αὐτῶν, κατὰ τόπον αὐτῶν, ἐν ταῖς χώραις αὐτῶν, καὶ ἐν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν αὐτῶν· ἡγεμὼν Θαμνὰ, ἡγεμὼν Γωλὰ, ἡγεμὼν Ἰεθὲρ,

verses.geez: ኤሌማ ፡ መስፍን ፡ ኢላ ፡ መስፍን ፡ ፈኖን ፡ መስፍን ፤
verses.translation: chief Olibema, chief Helas, chief Phinon,

translations.lxx: chief Olibema, chief Helas, chief Phinon,
translations.kjv: Duke Aholibamah, duke Elah, duke Pinon,
translations.ron: Căpetenia Olibama, căpetenia Ela, căpetenia Pinon,
translations.grk: ἡγεμὼν Ὁλιβεμὰς, ἡγεμὼν Ἡλὰς, ἡγεμὼν Φινὼν,

verses.geez: ቄኔዝ ፡ መስፍን ፡ ቴማን ፡ መስፍን ፡ ሚብሳር ፡ መስፍን ፤
verses.translation: chief Kenez, chief Thæman, chief Mazar,

translations.lxx: chief Kenez, chief Thæman, chief Mazar,
translations.kjv: Duke Kenaz, duke Teman, duke Mibzar,
translations.ron: Căpetenia Chenaz, căpetenia Teman, căpetenia Mibţar,
translations.grk: ἡγεμὼν Κενὲζ, ἡγεμὼν Θαιμὰν, ἡγεμὼν Μαζὰρ,

verses.geez:
መግዲኤል ፡ መስፍን ፡ ዒራም ፡ መስፍን ፤ እሉ ፡ እሙንቱ ፡ መሳፍንተ ፡ ኤዶም ፡ በበማኅደሮሙ ፡ ዘበምድሮሙ* ፡ ወለሊሁ
                  ፡ ዔሳው ፡ አቡሆሙ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ለኤዶም ።
verses.translation: chief Magediel, chief Zaphoin. These are the chiefs of Edom in their dwelling-places, in the land of their possession; this is Esau, the father of Edom.

translations.lxx: chief Magediel, chief Zaphoin. These are the chiefs of Edom in their dwelling-places, in the land of their possession; this is Esau, the father of Edom.
translations.kjv: Duke Magdiel, duke Iram: these be the dukes of Edom, according to their habitations in the land of their possession: he is Esau the father of the Edomites.
translations.ron: Căpetenia Magdiel, căpetenia Iram. Acestea sunt căpeteniile lui Edom, după aşezările lor în ţara stăpânită de ei. Acesta-i Isav, părintele Edomiţilor.
translations.grk: ἡγεμὼν Μαγεδιὴλ, ἡγεμὼν Ζαφωίν· οὗτοι ἡγεμόνες Ἐδὼμ, ἐν ταῖς κατῳκοδομημέναις ἐν τῇ γῇ τῆς κτήσεως αὐτῶν· οὗτος Ἡσαῦ πατὴρ Ἐδώμ.
